When you reached the Sanctum of Genesis,
Zaalhaut was waiting for you, looking impatient.{w}
"Just how long do you intend to keep ME waiting!?"{w}

"Listen well. There is something
I need you to obtain."{w}{p}"Defeat every one of the Qualia that guard
this Sanctum of Genesis, and claim their ranks."{w}{p}"Bear those ranks into the Coronation Hall,
and you can gain the Sun's Light Rank."{w}{p}"With the Sun's Light Rank,
Rafa can be made a true Sun Spirit."{w}{p}"Come on, let's get moving.
We can't stay here for long, you know."{w}

"That will be quite enough mischief, if you please."{w}
Turning toward the voice, you saw strange beings clad in light.{w}

"This is the Sanctum of Genesis, ruled by the Light of All Knowledge.{w}It is no place for those like yourselves,
whose soles are soiled with mud."{w}

"...Oh? How very odd.{w}You came to the Sanctum of Genesis last time as well, did you not?"{w}{p}"Why would you try to throw away
the life you were lucky enough to keep?"{w}
"Heh heh. I left a little something behind, you see."{w}
"I see. So this time you mean to use these people as a shield to reach the Coronation Hall."{w}

"No, you're wrong, Opinion Bit.{w}I'm the one who'll be dealing with you lot.
They're the ones heading to the Coronation Hall."{w}

"Allow me to confirm: you were nearly killed
by us once before, were you not?"{w}

"..........{w}...We have reached the conclusion that this cannot be understood."{w}{p}"We will set this topic aside.{w}Now, let us proceed with your elimination.
And after that, everyone behind you."{w}
Magic power enough to make you freeze in your tracks began to gather around the Opinion Bits.{w}
"The longer it grows, the closer it gets to the ground...{w}Do you know what it is?"{w}
The Opinion Bits each began to give off light once more and started exchanging auras.{w}{p}Before long, the Opinion Bits all turned toward Zaalhaut at once.{w}
"..........{w}...We have reached the conclusion that we are unable to answer."{w}{p}"We will set this topic aside. Please enlighten us as to the correct answer."{w}
"What is it... that has endless faces?"{w}
Just as before, the Opinion Bits began exchanging auras.{w}

"These things have a habit of needing to know exactly where a conversation starts and where it ends."{w}{p}"So the longer I keep them stumped, the more time I can buy.{w}...Now go, quickly, while you have the chance."{w}{p}"Don't worry about me.{w}I haven't lived such a feeble life that I need brats worrying about me."{w}{p}"Leave this to me, and hurry to the Coronation Hall."{w}
The question-and-answer session between Zaalhaut and the Opinion Bits goes on and on.{w}
"We will set this topic aside. Please enlighten us as to the correct answer."{w}
"That which is truly equal, that which walks on without ever looking back, that which is carved by a great sword and a small sword...{w}Do you know what it is?"{w}
"Hm?{w}What's this, you've decided to answer after all?{w}Too bad, though. The answer is 'time.'"{w}
"Surely the flow of time is the same for each and every thing in existence."{w}
"No, it is light.{w}That which falls equally upon all things -- that is light."{w}
"There is no such thing as time.{w}It is light."{w}
".........."{w}{p}"...Then what about the clue 'that which walks on without ever looking back'?"{w}

"It is light."{w}{p}"Light -- that is to say, the great Elnoa-Malem -- is the one who will abolish such foolish pacts of the past as the Phase Shift, and bring stability to the future of the Real Axis."{w}
"We have answered your question. This conversation is over.{w}Now then, your elimination..."{w}
"W-wait!{w}Then what about 'carved by a great sword and a small sword'!?"{w}{p}"That's supposed to mean the hands of a clock! You can't explain that, can you!?"{w}

"Why, light, naturally."{w}{p}"The lesser sin of you all defying us, the greater sin of failing to fulfill your duty of bringing forth the Eld..."{w}{p}"Those two swords, the lesser sin and the greater, wound the heart of the great Elnoa-Malem."{w}

"We have answered your question. This conversation is over.{w}Now then, let us carry out your elimination."{w}{p}"Those who set foot in the Sanctum of Genesis are fated to be judged by the Opinion of Light and the Opinion Bits."{w}
"...You who know too much.{w}Be burned by the holy light, and vanish."{w}
"Ha, just try it, you heartless lackeys!"{w}

"It is futile.{w}Even if one or two of us should fall, more of us will appear, however many it takes."{w}{p}"You never had a chance to begin with.{w}If you step aside, we will at least let you pass on without suffering. What will you do?"{w}

"No chance, you say?{w}Heh, you really do look down on me.
...This is a waste of time. Come at me, all of you at once."{w}
(Those kids will perform the rite of re-coronation and come back alive.{w}Buying them the time for that is all I need.){w}
"I am Zaalhaut, the child the wicked mage Zanu left behind.{w}

{0E}"I am Zaalhaut, the child the wicked mage Zanu left behind.{0F}
The cursed child that lust and a spirit's tears brought into this world!"{w}
"Let's see how long mere servants of a god can stand against this unblessed power of mine!"{w}

"So... I couldn't win after all...{w}In the end... all I can do...
is dance in the palm of a god's hand...?"{w}{p}"I can't hear anymore. My eyes are going dim.{w}I wonder if those kids pulled it off..."{w}
"The land where I was born... my precious place...{w}This... cursed body of mine...{w}the only... thing that ever... ac... cepted it..."{w}{p}"Mo... th... er...{w}I'm sor... ..."{w}
Spirits gathered around Zaalhaut.{w}Lifting up the body, they carried it all the way to the exit.{w}

You feel an overwhelming presence from the one called Spectoria, unlike anything you have felt before.{w}There is nowhere for you to run.{w}

"Ordinarily, the likes of you would be nothing more than a trifling matter."{w}{p}"But you have gone too far.{w}Anything more would go against the divine will."{w}{p}"You will now receive your punishment. Prepare yourselves."{w}

"As one would expect of those who made it all the way here."{w}{p}"It cannot be helped.{w}This time, and this time only, I shall withdraw."{w}{p}"But do not forget that you are always in the palm of our hand..."{w}

Spectoria vanished into the light.{w}{p}Having defeated the Qualia, you stood in the center of the room and raised all the Ranks you had obtained toward the sky.{w}They then turned into the shining [Sun's Light Rank].{w}

With a strange whirring, a Tetramystica glides across the floor.{w}{p}A Tetramystica specialized for guard duty -- a "Guard Mystica," you might call it.{w}{p}Here and there the students have scrawled on it: "Idiot," "Moron," even doodled nose hairs.{w}Even so, its function of guarding the Academy is still fully intact.{w}{p}So it is only natural that, on spotting you outsiders who don't belong to the Academy, it moves to eliminate you.{w}

You have run into a foe you never expected.{w}A vast form, its whole body blazing with light.{w}{p}Without a sound, the very air shudders and trembles.{w}With the word "alien" lodged in your hearts, you stand exposed to its savage power.{w}
Suddenly, a gigantic beast appears before you.{w}Half tiger and half horse, it flails its arms and thrashes its whole body wildly.{w}{p}And now its fury turns on you as well.{w}

Darkness within darkness.{w}Welling up from the abode of the Nether King, it fills the air around it with an incomprehensible tongue.{w}{p}What it is saying: unknown.{w}What it is even trying to do: unknown.{w}{p}But one thing is clear:
it means to destroy you.{w}

A giant leaps out in front of you.{w}It seems to be distracted by something else.{w}{p}It doesn't appear able to tell whether you are enemies or mere visitors.{w}{p}No -- for just a moment it seemed to give it some thought, but
'Eh, I'll just punch them for now and...'{w}seems to be the conclusion it reached.{w}
You succeeded in driving off the fearsome enemy.
"Wait, I haven't introduced everyone yet.{w}This is Mig.{w}A unicorn, as you can see."{w}{p}"Mig and I have been together since birth,{w}and Mig travels with me like this.{w}And..........."{w}
"Yamuru. I'm a bounty hunter.{w}I hear the Proclamation pays a pretty good sum,{w}so they've let me join this party."{w}
"My name is Korbitz.{w}We may end up relying on each other from here on,{w}so let's look out for one another, eh?"{w}
"The name's Mokero, it is!{w}The Miss has done a whole heap for me,{w}and I'll be followin' the Miss for the rest o' my days!"{w}

"Mokero, I keep telling you,
you don't have to be so formal..."{w}
"Miss! Don't go sayin' such cold things!{w}The debt I owe you, Miss, is............"{w}
"Electra's a kind child, you see,{w}and took us in, just like this.{w}So please, all of you, be good to Electra."{w}
"Ugh, honestly! You're all exaggerating!{w}If someone's in trouble, I help them.{w}
"Okay, okay, I get it!{w}Anyway, that's how it is, so be nice to all of us, okay?"{w}

"By the way... yours looks
like a pretty decent party."{w}

"We might end up competing with each other in all kinds of ways.{w}What do you say? How about you lot
and us have a little test of skill?"{w}
"These are the people who'll be our rivals from here on.{w}We need to see what they can do now, don't we?"{w}
"Besides, you need the bounty money, right?{w}Or was this something you started half-heartedly?"{w}

"Electra, what'll we do?
If you're going to fight, I'll help, okay?"{w}
"............Okay, I've made up my mind!"{w}{p}"You guys, let's have a match!{w}All right, everyone, let's go!!"{w}
"Ooh~ I'm gonna lop off some heads~!"{w}
"Not bad at all.{w}Still, Electra,{w}your alchemy spells are as half-baked as ever."{w}

"It's okay, Electra!
Your alchemy spells will get better from here on!"{w}
"It's all right,{w}there's no need to rush."{w}
"I'll be lendin' a hand too, I will!"{w}
"Everyone... thank you.{w}Okay, so that's how it is,{w}next time I'll be able to do a lot more!"{w}{p}"See you!"{w}
Electra and the others went on their way.{w}
"Look, alchemy spells and Rangers go well together.{w}But if your success rate's low, it's pointless."{w}
"I know that already!{w}That's why I'm studying like this, okay!?"{w}
"Don't be so hard on the Miss!{w}I'll be pitchin' in too, I will!"{w}
"That's right, Electra!{w}You can't go through life bending your convictions!{w}You can still do it! Hang in there!"{w}
"You're right... I'll try a little harder!"{w}
"There's no need to hurry, just go at your own pace...{w}

{0E}"There's no need to hurry, just go at your own pace...{0F}
Oh?"{w}
"Oh, it's you guys! What a coincidence!{w}

{0E}"Oh, it's you guys! What a coincidence!{0F}
How's it going? Things are going great for us!"{w}
"Come to think of it, you got the better of us last time.{w}It won't go that way this time, got it?"{w}
"Yamuru, you're more hot-blooded than you look.{w}Didn't you have a rule about never doing anything that doesn't pay?"{w}
"I'll be showin' what I'm made of too!"{w}

{0E}"Hm? Fine by me, but...{0F}
Okay, everyone, let's go!"{w}

{0E}"No, it's nothing.{0F}
You lot look like a pretty good party."{w}

"Well, it's parties like ours, with a unicorn,
that are the rare ones, y'know."{w}
"Having me around is proof of Innocence, after all!"{w}

{0E}"You're right.{0F}
We won't lose next time, you hear? See you!"{w}
Electra and the others went on their way.{w}
"But I really do need to study...{w}Even you can read and write, right, Yamuru?"{w}

"That's a harsh way to put it.
What good is a bounty hunter who can't read a wanted poster?"{w}

"I can't read, but
it's never been a problem, y'know?"{w}
"I'll teach you, then.{w}Perhaps we'll hold a little study session one of these days, hm?"{w}
"But what about textbooks... and the money for them?"{w}
"Oh! You again, in a place like this!"{w}
"We must share quite the bond of fate, eh?"{w}

"We've been getting stronger too, you know,
so we won't lose this time!"{w}

"Oh, that reminds me.
Do you guys know anything about the Moonlight Spirit?"{w}
"You really do march to your own beat.{w}The Moonlight Spirit? Don't you mean the Sun Spirit?"{w}
"Nope, the Moonlight Spirit.{w}I've been kinda sorta looking for it.{w}And since I can't find it, it bugs me even more~"{w}
"One way or another, you guys sure know a lot...{w}I really do need to study.{w}
"Ninja! Ninja's the way to go!{w}YAMURU IS DECAPITATED!{w}

"Oh, pipe down.{w}We don't neeeed a thief who can't
even disarm traps!"{w}
"That's right! Electra, don't give up!{w}You're gonna make loads of money as an alchemist, right?{w}Don't go bending your convictions!"{w}
"Look.{w}Electra, you need to knock it off too.{w}If you keep wavering any longer, I'm out."{w}
"Hold... on, Yamuru...{w}Where's this coming from all of a sudden...?"{w}
"Someone who's half-hearted drags everyone else down too."{w}
"Aw, don't go sayin' that, chief!{w}I'll just dig in all the harder to make up for it!"{w}

"That's right!
Electra's working really hard, you know!"{w}

"You'd better think a little harder{w}about what you're actually
saying."{w}
"Says the one who's already changed classes!"{w}
"...I'll stick with you a little longer, at least.{w}Studying's something you can start bit by bit, too.{w}Now give me an answer."{w}

"......Yeah... You're right...
I'll try a little harder...{w}...Is that okay?"{w}
"...Fine.{w}Anyway, we're moving on.{w}Hanging around here forever won't get us anywhere."{w}
"Right!{w}Well then, you guys take care too, okay?"{w}
Electra and the others went on their way.{w}
